status: Receipt/revision continuation of ordered unit 1; unit 1 and GPI-S4 remain incomplete.
change: Renderer session accumulates monotonic semantic changes; stronger damage cannot be downgraded by interaction hints.

Main and all owned dialog kinds share target-bound completion bridge. Failed, abandoned, foreign, superseded or retired receipts cannot acknowledge native semantic damage. Rejected completion returns failure to existing native scheduling owner.
Only successful matching native completion permits existing native hit publication. Capture cannot acknowledge native damage. Recovery transfer retires previous session target.

One allocator-scoped mailbox per session; frame begin clones its handle without allocation. Stale receipt drop cannot poison a new attempt; allocation remains observable when a receipt outlives its session.
verification_rationale: Negative controls decide whether this completion boundary is safe to build immutable frame/image reuse on. Focused app visual compile and affected-crate all-target Clippy verify both default native adapters and capture. No GPU graph or pixel output changes: reuse unit1 broader checks at their recorded scope; no new native/performance experiment.

review.scope: Read-only advisory review of revision/receipt continuation; no builds/tests/native runs or edits. Prepared ownership and immutable frame plan remain pending.
review.disposition: All UNIT2 findings resolved by follow-up source inspection. No remaining blocking finding in this bounded continuation. Advisory review only; no test execution by reviewer, full resource/performance acceptance or completed PM049 adoption claimed.

findings.finding: Failed completion clears active but does not invalidate interaction-only reuse; receipt drop leaves active without conservative state. After warm ack and Interaction, failure retains interaction_only=true; failed clean exposure leaves pending=false. Early errors/deferred exits drop the completion closure instead of reporting failure.
findings.required: Make failure/drop conservative for reuse and preserve required pending work; targeted warm-failure/drop controls. No stale cache is used yet, so this is a new owner contract flaw rather than demonstrated current image regression.
findings.resolution: Receipt Drop marks attempt abandonment; pending/reuse observes it, supersede promotes Target, and failed completion promotes Target. Early exits dropping closure therefore fail closed.

findings.finding: Receipt Target only compares with its own stored active copy; bridge supplies only a bool and never proves actual presented transaction target equals captured receipt Target. Same-session target-A receipt could acknowledge target-B successful presentation through public bridge. Current production sites pair correctly.
findings.required: Bind actual host/device/configuration presentation identity into completion verification; reject same-session wrong target, not only another Revisions owner. Ensure semantic rejection cannot clear coordinator work as a success.
findings.resolution: Completion receives actual host/device/configuration from SurfaceTransaction; all components must match. Shared bridge returns Err on rejected semantic receipt, preventing coordinator success acknowledgement.

findings.finding: Fresh Arc<AtomicBool> is allocated for every begin attempt without visible pre-admission/owned metadata charge. New transient/live receipt heap storage must retain the approved full resource-accounting boundary.
findings.required: Reuse a bounded charged session mailbox with attempt discrimination, or explicitly admit/charge new receipt allocation and its ownership lifetime. This is separate from resolved receipt correctness findings.
findings.resolution: One session-owned Arc<AtomicU64> mailbox replaces per-attempt allocation. begin clones an existing handle; stale Drop compare_exchange is keyed to monotonically unique attempt and cannot clear the current mailbox. The mailbox is created in cpu_alloc Scope render-session-receipt, so actual payload, header and owner lifetime remain visible through standard cpu_alloc::usage/native resource observation, including a receipt outliving its session. Added focused test source covers allocation-free begin, pointer identity, stale drop and outliving lifetime; reviewer did not execute it.

positive_findings: Strong revision preserves mixed Composition/Interaction dominance independent of update order.
Completing an older native revision leaves newer changes pending.
Foreign owner, superseded attempt and explicitly retired target receipts are rejected.
Capture completion never acknowledges native damage.
Recovery transfer calls retire_target, invalidating prior attempts and promoting strong pending revision.
No new selection/history behavior change in this continuation found.
